description: Performance budgets for bundle size enforcement. Caps are set from the 2026-09-26 measured build (post PurgeCSS rewrite, locale chunk split, assetsInlineLimit: 0) plus ~7-10% headroom.

default.description: Default chunk size limit (97kb raw, 30kb gzip). Measured: i18n 54652 raw / 18278 gzip.

vendor.description: Vendor chunk limit (195kb raw, 68kb gzip). Measured: vendor 195288 raw / 63621 gzip.

main.description: Main chunk limit (156kb raw, 58kb gzip). Measured: index 142147 raw / 51497 gzip. Tightened below the pre-inline-removal level so re-inlining assets is caught.

total.description: Total JS bundle size limit (410kb raw, 156kb gzip). Measured: 392676 raw / 133765 gzip.

assets.description: Individual non-JS asset limit (137kb). Measured: index CSS 133282.
